title: Fluorescent probes for sensing and visualizing methylglyoxal: progress, challenges, and perspectives
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38757-38777
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07512A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jing Wen, Qingya Zhang, Liyi Zhou
Developing effective tools for MGO is of great significance for studying pathogenesis. In this work, we provide a brief overview of recent research on fluorescent probes used for MGO biosensing in living cells, tissues, and animals.
